purpose: Display area data in a chart.
avoid: Do not rely only on color, geometry or hover for access to the values.
basis: Native source page 201:20 (Area), observed anatomy and examples.
openDecisions: Data schema, units/scales, legends, equivalent data table, text summary and interactive tooltip behavior.
profileRationale: Meaningful content or content container; not classified as decorative. Any interactive descendants need separate behavior and accessibility contracts.
